Assistant: <think>
ground_truth: There are $\binom{10}{3}=120$ ways to select exactly three dice to roll 1's ones out of ten dice total. Since $117 = 9 \times 13$, we can simplify this as follows: $\sqrt{117} = \sqrt{(9 \times 13)} = \sqrt{9} \times \sqrt{13} = 3\sqrt{13}$ feet. The perimeter of the rhombus is four times this amount or $4 \times 3\sqrt{13} = \boxed{12\sqrt{13}\text{ feet}}$.
